notes: Datasheet hosted at amphenol-cs.com/optics.html; legal entity repeated as XGIGA Communication Technology Co.,ltd. Receiver sensitivity (-3.7 dBm OMA per lane) measured with PRBS31Q, BER@2.4*10^-4, for TECQ<0.9 dB; alternate formula -4.6+TECQ for 0.9 dB≤TECQ≤SECQ. Transmit OMA min: 0.8 dBm for TDECQ<0.9 dB; -0.1+TDECQ for 0.9 dB≤TDECQ≤3.4 dB. Average launch power off per lane Poff -16 dBm. RIN17.1OMA max -139 dB/Hz. Optical receiver damage threshold Pdmg 5.9 dBm per lane. Total output average launch power Pout and several electrical parameters marked TBD. Power dissipation stated as <16 W in features; Total Power max 16 W in electrical table. Supply current Icc max 4848 mA at Vcc 3.3 V. Signaling speed 113.4375 ± 50 ppm GBd per lane. Host must implement FEC for reliable operation; no module FEC type specified.
